title: Quest Foglight for Databases renderTemplateString Server-Side Template Injection Remote Code… (CVE-2026-92196)
description: CVE-2026-92196 is a server-side template injection vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases affecting the renderTemplateString method. It allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges due to improper validation of user-supplied input before template processing. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.2.
